subject.title: feat(skills): capture reusable techniques from successful work

question: Should an existing persisted skills.workshop.autonomous.enabled=true value automatically authorize post-run transcript review and additional background model spend, or must users explicitly consent to this broader behavior?
rationale: The PR changes the privacy, cost, and runtime meaning of an existing persisted setting; code review cannot determine whether that upgrade behavior matches maintainer product intent.

options.title: Require explicit experience-review consent
options.body: Keep existing correction capture compatible and enable delayed transcript review only after a new or migrated explicit consent action.

options.title: Broaden the existing setting
options.body: Treat every existing true value as consent for both correction capture and delayed experience review, with the documented cost and privacy tradeoff.

options.title: Pause the core feature
options.body: Do not add post-run transcript review to core until the consent and ownership model is settled.

recommendation.title: Require explicit experience-review consent
recommendation.body: Keep existing correction capture compatible and enable delayed transcript review only after a new or migrated explicit consent action.
